definition: a metal container with a lid for paint
description: A sunny roof terrace. The view rises from open paint cans, a pink lid and a stirring stick on a dust sheet to a young woman in paint-splashed white dungarees on a stepladder. She tips a whole can of bright pink paint against a tall white wall, the paint pouring down in a thick stream and dripping onto the floor, then holds the empty can in front of her. On a wicker sofa behind her a young woman in jeans holds a drink and laughs. Potted palms and a line of small flags stand under a blue sky.

taps.phrase: to watch from a wicker sofa
